Name: LOBBY_MENU_PARAM_ST
Description: Destinations of the Roundtable Hold travel menu (Expeditions, Character Selection, Change Garb ...): names, map icons, warp points and the flags that show them or open their menu on arrival.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Set: the row is left out of the network test build. Retail: set on 6 rows.

Fields.Name: Name ID
Fields.Description: The text to use for the name of this menu.

Fields.Name: Warp Point Entity ID
Fields.Description: Point Entity ID to warp to.

Fields.Name: Menu Auto Open Event Flag
Fields.Description: Flag to automatically open menu upon warping.

Fields.Name: Appearance Event Flag
Fields.Description: Flag to display in Roundtable menu.

Fields.Name: Flagged Warp Value
Fields.Description: Passed to the warp when this destination is picked, but only while event flag 10000926 is on. What it changes is not established. Retail 1 (Expeditions, Character Selection, Relic Rites) or 2.

Fields.Name: Map Position Entity ID
Fields.Description: Point Entity ID to place the map icon at.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail 0 on every row.
